飞：PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，国航132，我们刚截获来自国航206的紧急呼叫，一名乘客疑似心脏病发作，请求优先着陆，飞机的位置BAV东50千米，8100米保持。
问：根据报告，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: A transmission of CCA132 was intercepted
A passenger in CCA132 had a heart attack
choicesZh: 国航132上一名乘客心脏病发作
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. CCA206 requested priority landing

cards.audioText:
Capital airport information F 1500UTC. Wind calm, VIS 8 kilometers, CAVOK. Temperature 15, dew point 12, QNH 1008. Landing runway 02L and 02R. Runway 02L landing localizer not operational.
Q: Which of the following statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
首都机场情报通播F，世界协调时1500，静风，能见度8千米，CAVOK（云层和能见度良好）。温度15，露点12，修正海压1008。降落跑道02左和02右。跑道02左航向道不工作。
问：下列哪项陈述是正确的？
choices: Runway 02L cannot be used for landing
Either runway 02R or 02L can be used for ILS approach
Runway 02L cannot be used for ILS approach
Runway 20R can be used for ILS approach
choicesZh: 跑道02右或跑道02左可以仪表着陆
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Runway 02L cannot be used for ILS approach

cards.audioText:
Captain: The right engine exhaust gas temperature is approaching starting limit right now. It seems to be a hot start. We're commencing aborting engine start procedure.
Maintenance: Roger. We'll check it for you after it's fully shutdown.
Q: What was the captain's concern with the right engine?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：右发动机排气温度正在接近启动极限，可能是热启动。我们正在执行发动机中止起动程序。
维修：收到，我们会在发动机彻底熄火后检查。
问：机长关注的是右发动机的哪种故障？
choices: The weather was too hot to start the right engine
The right engine had exceeded the exhaust gas limit
The right engine appeared to have had a hot start
The right engine automatically shut down due to hot start
choicesZh: 天气过热无法启动右发动机
右发动机温度超过排气温度限制
右发动机似乎出现热启动
因为热启动右发动机自动熄火
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The right engine appeared to have had a hot start

cards.audioText:
CTL: SIA321, taxi to holding point G1, follow B737 taxing southbound on the apron on your right. Caution work in progress adjacent to the taxiway, north of the intersection of taxiways A and D3.
Q: Where was the work in progress?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：新航321，滑行到等待点G1，跟随右边在停机坪向南滑行的B737。注意滑行道A和D3的交叉口附近正在施工。
问：哪里正在施工？
choices: In the middle of a taxiway intersection
To the north, on the apron
On one side of taxiway D3
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. On one side of taxiway D3

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Beijing Approach, CES5231, engine-driven generator inoperative, VYK 32, 5100m, using battery feeding. Endurance 0040. Request priority landing.
CTL: CES5231, Beijing Approach. Follow VYK01 Arrival, runway 18L. You are number one.
PIL: Follow VYK01 Arrival, runway 18L, CES5231.
Q: How long can CES5231 stay in the air with the fuel remaining?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，北京进近，东方5231，发动机发电机失效，VYK 32分，5100米，使用电力供电。续航时间40分钟，请求优先着陆。
管：东方5231，北京进近，VYK01进场程序，跑道18左，你是第一个。
飞：VYK01进场程序，跑道18左，东方5231。
问：东方5231的剩余燃油还可以飞行多久？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 40 minutes

cards.audioText:
When the captain discovered that onboard there was an obese passenger who had taken up nearly two seats, he refused to take off. While some people feared that this was a policy violation, the captain explained that he was concerned the passenger could not be safely evacuated in an emergency.
Q: According to the statement, the captain was concerned about which type of passenger?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长发现机上有肥胖乘客，这位乘客几乎占据两个座位的空间，机长拒绝起飞。有些人担心这样会违反政策，机长解释他担心这位乘客在紧急情况下无法安全疏散。
问：根据陈述，机长担心哪类乘客？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Overweight

cards.audioText:
During climbing, the aircraft nearly stalled. The flight crew suspected it was probably because the cargo wasn't tied down properly and shifted in the rear hold, so the captain requested return.
Q: Why did the pilot request return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机在爬升阶段几乎失速，机组成员怀疑可能是货物未被正确地固定，所以在后货舱移动。机长请求返回。
问：为什么飞行员请求返回？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Cargo improperly fixed

cards.audioText:
The weather forecast reported that a tornado around 6km in diameter was in the north of the Hainan area, and there was severe turbulence in that area. Scattered cumulonimbus with maximum tops to 15000m.
Q: Which weather condition was not mentioned in the report?
cards.audioTextZh:
天气预报报告海南地区北部有直径6千米的龙卷风，并有严重颠簸。分布广泛的积雨云最高高度到15000米。
问：哪一种天气情况在天气预报中未被提到？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Heavy rain

cards.audioText:
For pre-flight checks, the captain generally performs the walk-around, gets the weather and deals with Weight and Balance. The captain is usually reviewing the weather, flight plan, NOTAMs, performance and fuel issues.
Q: According to the statement, who will do the walk-around check?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行前的检查中，机长通常绕飞机进行检查，接收天气信息，并处理载重与平衡。机长通常再次检查天气、飞机计划、航行通告、性能和燃油问题。
问：根据陈述，谁要做绕机检查？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Captain

cards.audioText:
Captain: Our right wing tip must have been hit by birds, leading edge flap sustained minor damage.
Mechanic: OK, I will have a check and fix the problem.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：飞机右翼尖肯定遭遇过鸟击，前缘襟翼受到轻微损坏。
修理工：好的，我会进行检查并解决问题。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: Leading edge flap was damaged by a birdstrike
Leading edge flap received minor damage
Right wing was damaged by a birdstrike
choicesZh: 前缘襟翼由于鸟击被损坏
前缘襟翼受到轻微损坏
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Leading edge flap received minor damage

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, ACA867, No.2 engine flame out, fire under control now, dense smoke is spreading in cabin, some passengers are coughing heavily due oxygen masks out of service, request priority landing and medical assistance on arrival.
CTL: ACA867, roger, turn right heading 120, radar vector for ILS approach runway 01.
Q: According to the passage, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，加航867，2号发动机冒出火焰，现在火情得到控制。客舱内有浓烟，由于氧气面罩失效，一些乘客剧烈咳嗽。请求优先着陆并申请到达时医疗救援。
管：加航867，收到，右转航向120，雷达引导盲降跑道01。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: Fire on board was out of control
The pilot requested descent due to depressurization
There was choking smoke in the cabin
choicesZh: 由于降压飞行员申请下降
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was choking smoke in the cabin

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA918, No.2 engine flamed out, request dump fuel and return to Beijing airport.
CTL: CCA918, direct to YV, after YV fly heading 350 radar vector for fuel dumping, start dump. When fuel dump completed, turn left heading 255, climb to and maintain 4500m.
Q: What was the initial heading for fuel dumping?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航918，2号发动机熄火，请求放油后返回北京机场。
管：国航918，直飞YV，过YV后航向350，雷达引导放油，开始放油。放油完成后左转航向255，上升保持4500米。
问：放油时最初航向是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 350

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, CSN203, we have been struck by an unidentified object, rear fuselage damaged, right flap lost, request priority landing and radar vector to final approach.
CTL: CSN203, you are number one, radar vector for landing.
Q: Why did the pilot ask for priority landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，南航203，飞机受到不明物体击打，机身后部受损，右襟翼丢失，请求优先着陆，雷达引导五边进近。
管：南航203，你是第一个，雷达引导着陆。
问：为什么飞行员请求优先着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fuselage damage

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CSN303, 4 hijackers with guns are attempting to hijack our aircraft, they're holding 2 of the flight attendants hostage, and have hurt 3 passengers. Request immediate landing.
CTL: CSN303, roger, cleared ILS approach runway 22, you are number one.
Q: According to the passage, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，南航303, 4名持枪劫机者企图劫持我们的飞机，他们劫持了2名空乘人员，3名乘客受伤。申请立即降落。
管：南航303，收到，可以跑道22盲降进近，你是第一个。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: There were 2 hijackers in the cabin
3 flight attendants in the cabin were hurt
3 passengers in the cabin were hurt
choicesZh: 恐怖分子没有携带武器
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3 passengers in the cabin were hurt

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Guangzhou Approach, CSN3517, we have a fire in the rear cabin, request emergency descent.
CTL: Roger MAYDAY, descend to and maintain 1800m, we've informed firefighting units.
PIL: Fire under control now, request priority landing as a precaution, CSN3517.
Q: Where was the fire?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，广州进近，南航3517，客舱后部起火，请求紧急下降。
管：收到MAYDAY，下降保持1800米，已经通知消防单位。
飞：火情已得到控制，为预警请求优先着陆，南航3517。
问：飞机哪个部分起火？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The rear cabin

cards.audioText:
Pilots communicate with ATC using radio telephone, but radio is not always reliable. Various disturbances can make communication unsmooth, and even radio broadcasting sometimes cut in and out.
Q: Which of the following was mentioned as a possible cause of radio interference?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员使用无线电话与ATC进行沟通，但是无线电并不总是可靠。各种干扰会让沟通不顺畅，有时无线电广播的声音甚至会时有时无地出现。
问：以下哪项是被提到为无线电干扰的可能原因？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio broadcasting

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, CCA101, 8900m maintaining, we encountered icing when descending through the fog layer, request continue descent, buildup of ice on the windshield wipers.
CTL: CCA101, roger MAYDAY, descend to 3900m.
Q: According to the pilot, which of the following is likely true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY。北京区调，国航101，8900米保持，我下降穿过雾层时遭遇积冰，请求继续下降，雨刷结冰。
管：国航101，收到MAYDAY，下降到3900米。
问：根据飞行员所说，以下哪项可能是正确的？
choices: The aircraft was holding due to dense fog
The aircraft encountered strong wind shear
The windshield of the aircraft was broken
choicesZh: 由于浓雾飞机正在等待
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The aircraft encountered heavy icing

cards.audioText:
PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, AFR4095, Boeing 737, we’ve shutdown No.2 engine due to a bird strike, heading now 320, altitude 600m, current position 10 miles south of RTD, request return for immediate landing.
Q: Why was the engine shutdown?
cards.audioTextZh:
Panpan，Panpan，Panpan，法航4095，波音737，由于鸟击，我们关闭了2号发动机，航向320，高度600米，目前位置在RTD以南10海里，请求返回机场并立即着陆。
问：发动机为什么关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of a bird strike.

cards.audioText:
PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, NWA401 declaring an emergency, we have to shut down No.2 engine due to bird strike and engine lost power, request return for immediate landing. Current position 10 miles south of YHU.
Q: Why was the engine shutdown?
cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，美西北401宣告进入紧急状况，由于鸟击和发动机失去动力，我们必须关闭2号发动机，请求返回立刻着陆。当前位置YHU南10海里。
问：为什么要关闭2号发动机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because of bird ingestion

cards.audioText:
A: Did you hear what captain Michael said? There were something about the date when the flight plan reports would be true.
B: Yes, he said we did hand the flight plan reporting whenever we finish the filing, but they must be on Nov. 13rd if not before.
Q: When would the flight plan reports be given to the captain?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你听到Michael机长说的了吗？有关于上交飞行计划报告的日期的事可能是真的。
B：是的，他说我们写完后随时可以上交，但是最晚在11月13日上交。
问：飞行计划报告要在什么时候交给机长？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. On or before November 13

cards.audioText:
There are some basic common-sense practices you need to follow when making radio calls, and the important one is to listen before you transmit, keening the transmitter when someone else is transmitting will jam the frequency, remember, it’s a party line, it’s unprofessional and ineffective to stab on a communication between others.
Q: What is the man mainly talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
当进行无线电通话时，你需要遵循一些常识，重要的一点就是发话之前先听别人说，当别人发报时，你如果一直占用发报机会造成频率阻塞，记住，这是个公共频道，别人交流的时候插话是不专业也是低效行为。
问：说话人主要讨论的是什么？
choices: Proper ways to make radio calls.
choicesZh: 无线电通话的合理方式。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Proper ways to make radio calls.

cards.audioText:
My friend is really angry at the airline. Last week, he had a reservation for a flight to Shanghai for an important meeting. But he couldn't get on the flight even though he got to the airport in plenty of time. The gate personal apologized and offered him some money but he refused the money, instead he’s taking legal action against the airline.
Q: Which statement is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空公司让我的朋友很生气。上周，他预定了去上海的机票，去参加一个重要的会议，他早早到达了机场，但是却无法上飞机。值机工作人员对此深表歉意，并答应给予资金赔偿，但是他拒绝了资金赔偿，并决定采取法律手段来起诉航空公司。
问：下列表述正确的是？
choices: He was late to the airport.
He had to buy another ticket.
choicesZh: 他到机场的时候迟到了。
他将不会采取法律手段。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. He didn't take the money.

cards.audioText:
We were at 10500m, and there was increasing turbulence, other flights were reporting much less turbulence at 12500m, but we were still too heavy to go that high. The controller said we could either climb to 11500m or descend to below 9500m, there was a lot of traffic in the area so our choices were limited.
Q: Which of the following altitude could be requested?
cards.audioTextZh:
我们当前高度10500米，颠簸越来越严重，其他飞行员报告说12500米上颠簸较少，但是我们飞机太重，无法爬升到这个高度。管制员告诉我们可以继续上升到11500米，或者下降到9500米以下，但是9500米区域内有很多航空器，因此，我们的选择有限。
问：飞行员可能会申请的高度是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 11,500m.

cards.audioText:
The localizer transmitter is situated on the extended runway center line beyond the stop end. The localizer being normally defines a center line of the runway and extends along the approach path for 25 miles with 40 ILS channels within the frequency range of 108.10 to 111.95mhz to provide pilots with course guidance.
Q: What is localizer used for?
cards.audioTextZh:
航道信标发射台位于跑道中心延长线穿过跑道尽头。信标台通常在跑道中心延长线上，在25海里进近航迹上，在40个ILS频率中，频率范围108.10到111.95兆赫，为飞行员提供指引。
问：信标台的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Horizontal guidance

cards.audioText:
Aircraft manufactures are using light materials to construct aircraft and reduce fuel costs. However, some new aircraft may not be as effective as surviving lightning strikes as older aircraft which were built with aluminum, a good conductor. The carbon fiber wingtip of some original plane is an example. In a recent incident the wingtip of CRJ was reportedly damaged by lightning.
Q: What safety problem may new aircraft have due to lighter weight materials?
cards.audioTextZh:
目前，飞机制造商用轻型材料来建造飞机，以此降低燃油消耗。但是，一些此类的新型飞机无法像铝制飞机那样，有效避免雷击损伤，因为铝是一种良好的导体。其中，一些传统飞机的碳纤维翼尖就是很好的例证，在最近的几次事故中，CRJ的翼尖多次报告受损。
问：由于轻型材料的使用，新型飞机遇到了什么安全问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Damage by lightning.

cards.audioText:
Most radios of current manufactures have the 360 or 720 channel capacity. 360-channel radio uses 50 KHz spacing between the channels, such as 118.05 and 118.0. 720-channel doubles the frequencies available by using 25 KHz spacing.
Q: What spacing does a 360-channel radio have between channels?
cards.audioTextZh:
目前大多数的广播使用360或720的信道容量。360信道广播在信道间使用50千赫间隔，例如118.05和118.0。720信道的可用频率是360信道的双倍，使用的是25千赫间隔。
问：360信道广播信道间的间隔是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 50 KHz channel spacing

cards.audioText:
A: Do you know there is a word that controllers use to inform the pilot to know a taxi clearance issued at the beginning of a transmission?
B: Yes, there's an ICAO standard word.
Q: What word should be used in the situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：管制员会在传送最初使用某个词通知飞行员得知滑行许可，你知道这个词吗？
B：是的，ICAO中有标准词语。
问：这种情况下应该使用哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Acknowledge

cards.audioText:
Weather conditions are important, so pilots often receive weather updates. Updated weather information includes wind speed and direction. If the wind direction is changing, the heading is given a range such as variable from 150 to 210 degrees. This information is particular important for takeoff and landing.
Q: Besides speed, what other information about wind is particularly important for takeoff and landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
气象条件很重要，因此，飞行员经常收到气象更新清况。更新后的天气信息包括风速和风向。如果风向改变，航向也会随之变化，如150度-210度之间变动。这对于起飞和着陆来说，尤为重要。
问：除了风速，在起飞和降落期间，风的其他什么信息尤为重要？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. wind direction

cards.audioText:
Heathrow information C, clouds scattered at 3000 feet, broken at 5000 feet, wind 210 at 8 knots, visibility 2 miles in light rain, report established on ILS runway 23.
Q: What is the cloud cover at 5000 ft?
cards.audioTextZh:
希斯罗机场通播C，散云3000英尺，多云5000英尺，风向210，8节，小雨中能见度2海里，建立盲降进近跑道23后报。
问：5000英尺处的云是什么云？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Broken layer.

cards.audioText:
In the early days flight, pilot would find their way by following landmarks such as rivers, streams or railroads. This method is called pilotage. Today fly by pilotage is normally accomplished by comparing symbols on aeronautical charts with the corresponding features on the earth surface.
Q: Which of the following can best explain pilotage flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
在早期飞行时，飞行员通过观察河流，溪流，铁路等一些地标来进行导航，这一方式被称为地标领航。如今地标领航就是将航图上的符号和地表的一些地物特征进行比对。
问：以下哪项叙述解释了地标领航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Visual flight.

cards.audioText:
Good morning ladies and gentlemen, from the flight deck. Welcome aboard Transworld airlines flight 455 to St louis. We have leveled off and cruising at 35000 feet. We are turning off the fasten seat belts sign now, but for your safety, please keep your seat belts fastened when in your seats.
Q: Which of the following is flight 455 now doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
女士们，先生们，这里是机长广播，欢迎乘坐环球航空455航班前往圣路易斯。我们已经平飞，巡航高度35000英尺。现在，我们关闭了安全带指示灯，但是，为了你的安全，请您在就坐期间依然系好安全带。
问：环球航空455航班现在在干吗？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Cruising.

cards.audioText:
Some kinds of weather can severely degrade the performance of an aircraft such as turbulence and mountain waves. Icing conditions can also be very dangerous. Pilots need to know that freezing rain, clouds or drizzle can cause ice to build up on the critical surfaces of an aircraft.
Q: What kind of weather causes severe icing conditions?
cards.audioTextZh:
一些天气条件，如颠簸和地形波会严重降低飞机的性能。积冰对飞机来说也是十分危险的，飞行员应知道，冻雨，云和细雨都会造成积冰，并堆积在飞机重要的操纵面上。
问：什么样的天气会造成严重积冰？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. freezing rain or drizzle.

cards.audioText:
Passengers on a flight to Shanghai from Beijing are angry at the airline. About 20 minutes after takeoff, they had to turn back because the cabin temperature was very hot. The cabin crew had doubted the air conditioning problem even before they take off and had informed the captain but he decided to take off anyway. After returning to Beijing, the airline didn’t apologize or offer compensation for the delay which was more than 3 hours.
Q: When was the captain informed of the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
从北京前往上海航班上的乘客对航空公司很生气。起飞后约20分钟，飞机由于客舱温度过热而返航。乘务员早在起飞前就怀疑是空调系统出了问题，并上报给了机长，但是，机长依旧决定起飞。返航到北京后，航空公司没有任何道歉或者为本次延误提供补偿，即便延误超过了3小时。
问：机长是什么时候得知飞机问题的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. before takeoff.

cards.audioText:
An aircraft has just taken off. The crew's expecting to turn right and proceed to waypoint YB which is the exit point on the SID. As they pass 600 meters, departure control instructs them to turn right and proceed direct to VINIE, a waypoint that the crew doesn't understand or recognized, so the crew decides to contact departure control.
Q: Why does the crew need to contact departure control?
cards.audioTextZh:
一架飞机刚刚起飞，飞机本应该右转继续直飞航线YB，航点在SID的出口点。但是飞机通过600米时，离场管制指挥飞机右转继续直飞VINIE，但这个航点机组不清楚也无法识别，所以机组决定联系离场管制。
问：为什么机组决定联系离场管制？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Waypoint VINIE is unrecognized

cards.audioText:
Situations which require immediate crew action are indicated by red warning lights, located in the area of the pilot’s primary field vision. Situations which require timely crew action by the flight crew are indicated by amber caution lights. Blue lights do not require immediate crew attention.
Q: Which lights require timely crew action according to the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
需要飞行机组成员立即做出更正行为的状况用红色警告灯指示，位于飞行员主要视角范围内。需要飞行机组及时做出更正行为的状况用琥珀色警示灯。蓝色灯不需要机组及时关注。
问：根据陈述，什么灯要求机组及时做出更正行为？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Amber lights.

cards.audioText:
Regulations specify when you must use supplemental oxygen. If you are performing a flight with the cruise altitude over 12000 feet, you should consult these regulations. As a general rule, consider using supplemental oxygen when you fly above 10000 feet during the day or above 5000 feet at night.
Q: When, generally speaking, should supplemental oxygen be used?
cards.audioTextZh:
条例明确规定了什么时候使用补充氧气，当你计划飞行的巡航高度超过12000英尺时，你需要参阅此规定。作为总则，当你白天飞行超过10000英尺，夜间飞行超过5000英尺时，你都需要参阅此规定。
问：一般而言，你什么时候需要使用补充氧气？
choicesZh: 白天超过10000英尺，夜间超过5000英尺。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Over 10,000ft daytime and 5,000ft at night

cards.audioText:
A British airway's Boeing 737 skidded off the runway at Orly airport in Paris on Nov 16th, 2006 while landing in bad weather. There were no fatalities although 10 passengers and 2 crew members were injured. The plane received minor undercarriage damage.
Q: How many people died in the accident in Paris?
cards.audioTextZh:
2006年11月16日，英航一架波音737飞机在不良天气条件下降落巴黎奥利机场时滑出跑道，尽管有10名乘客和2名机组成员受伤，但是没有人死亡。飞机的起落架受到了一点损伤。
问：在此次巴黎机场事故中，有多少人死亡？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. None.

cards.audioText:
RVR is runway visual range represents the range which the runway is high-intensity lights could be seen in the direction of landing along the runway. RVR values and measured 3 points along the runway. These are touchdown point, mid-point and end-point also known as stop end.
Q: At which runway points is RVR NOT measured?
cards.audioTextZh:
跑道视程（RVR）表示的是沿着跑道着陆方向上能看到的强灯光的距离。跑道视程测量沿跑道方向3个点的值，分别是：接地点，中间段和终止端也叫停止端。
问：跑道视程不检测的点是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Threshold.

cards.audioText:
The safety investigation showed that the flight was under time pressure because of the duty time limits for the crew. Fog was rolling in and visibility was near or below the minimum for legal takeoff. If they didn't take off soon, they would have to return to the gate and delay the flight for another day so the captain decided to take off immediately.
Q: Why did the captain decide to take off in poor conditions?
cards.audioTextZh:
安全调查显示，航班面临着时间压力，原因是来自机组成员的工作时限。机场布满大雾，能见度接近或低于最低起飞标准，如果不马上起飞，他们就必须滑回停机位，然后航班推迟到第二天。于是，机长决定立即起飞。
问：机长为什么在不利天气条件下起飞？
choices: It was safe to take off.
Duty time limits might be exceeded.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Duty time limits might be exceeded.

cards.audioText:
First Officer: Captain, the controller inquired whether you could maintain visual of the Northwest DC-9 after takeoff for minimum separation.
Captain: I can keep the deck angle high and not let the speed build up to increase the separation.
Q: What did the controller ask for?
cards.audioTextZh:
副驾驶：机长，管制员询问是否可以保持对起飞的西北航空DC-9的目视，以保持最小间隔。机长：我可以保持高的迎角，不让速度增加，以此来增大间隔。
问：管制员要求了什么？
choices: To keep minimum separation with takeoff traffic.
To increase the separation with the traffic.
To maintain IFR with the takeoff traffic.
choicesZh: 保持与起飞航空器的最小间隔。
与起飞航空器保持仪表飞行规则。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To keep minimum separation with takeoff traffic.

cards.audioText:
Flight Attendant: Captain, there is panic in the cabin, some passengers are scared. They are terrified at the fire outside the right window.
Captain: Roger. Advise passengers to remain calm. Everything is under control. We are on final. We will land very soon.
Q: Why were the passengers frightened?
cards.audioTextZh:
乘务员：机长，客舱里一片恐慌，有一些乘客很害怕，他们看到右侧发动机起火后很惶恐。机长：收到，告诉乘客保持镇静，一切尽在掌控之中，我们加入五边了，马上就可以着陆。
问：乘客为什么恐慌？
choices: One passenger caught fire in the cabin.
The captain could not manage it finally.
choicesZh: 客舱一位乘客身上起火了。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Starboard engine on fire.

cards.audioText:
Captain: The braking pressure is not sufficient. We suspected there must be a leak in the hydraulic system.
Mechanic: We are working on it. But all hydraulic lines seem to be in good order.
Q: Why did the pilot suspect a leakage in the hydraulic system?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：刹车压力不足，我们怀疑液压系统液压油泄漏。机务：我们正着手处理，但是所有的液压管线看起来都情况良好。
问：飞行员为什么怀疑液压系统泄漏？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Not adequate pressure.

cards.audioText:
Good morning, ladies and gentlemen, from the flight deck, welcome aboard EVA airline flight 455 to Hongkong, we have leveled off and cruising at 35000ft, we are turning off the “fasten the seatbelt” signs now but for your safety, please make your seatbelts while in your seat.
Q: Which of the following is flight 455 now doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
女士们，先生们，早上好，这里是机长广播，欢迎乘坐长荣航空455航班前往香港。我们已经平飞，巡航高度35000英尺。现在，我们关闭了安全带指示灯，但是，为了你的安全，请您在就坐期间依然系好安全带。
问：455航班现在在干吗？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Cruising.

cards.audioText:
Ground, CES5056, we found some mistakes with the takeoff center of gravity and zero fuel center of gravity when we were checking the loading sheet. Would you recheck it and correct the mistakes?
Q: What do you learn from the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
地面，东方5056，我们检查舱单时，发现起飞重心和零燃油重心的一些错误。你可以再检查一遍并改正这些错误吗？
问：从表述中，可以得到什么？
choices: Correct calculation on the loading sheet.
Wrong calculation on the loading sheet.
The ground personnel found the mistakes.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wrong calculation on the loading sheet.

cards.audioText:
During the ground roll, the airplane direction of movement may be changed by carefully apply pressure on one break, or uneven pressures on each brake in the desired direction.
Q: How should you control the direction with breaks during ground roll?
cards.audioTextZh:
在地面滑跑过程中，飞机的运动方向可以通过小心地在一个刹车脚蹬上施加压力来改变，或者在期望的方向上对每个刹车脚蹬上施加不均匀的压力。
问:在地面滑跑过程中，你应该如何用刹车控制方向？
choices: Apply different pressure on each brake.
Apply same pressure on each brake.
Apply even pressure on each brake.
Apply add pressure on each brake.
choicesZh: 在每个刹车脚蹬上施加不同的压力
在每个刹车脚蹬上施加相同的压力
在每个刹车脚蹬上施加相等的压力
在每个刹车脚蹬上施加增加的压力
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Apply different pressure on each brake.

cards.audioText:
This is the captain speaking, welcome onboard flight 305 to New York, we have closed the doors at this time, however, there will be a short delay due to the air traffic congestion, we have been informed that we will have to wait another 10 minutes to push back
Q: How long will flight 305 have to wait before pushback?
cards.audioTextZh:
这里是机长广播，欢迎乘坐305航班飞往纽约，现在客舱门已经关闭，但由于航路拥挤，预计有短暂延误，我们被告知，还要继续等10分钟才推出。
问：在推出前，305航班还要等多久？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 10 minutes.

cards.audioText:
The airspeed indicator is marked in nm/h called knots for short. Knots are a measure of speed based on nautical or sea miles. Aviation uses both nautical and statute miles for measuring distances and speeds.
Q: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
空速表用海里/小时标注，也被简称为节，节是一个基于海里的测速单位，在民航用语中，经常用海里或者法定英里来表示距离和速度。
问：以下没有提及的是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Mach number.

cards.audioText:
A flight director we found on the primary flight instrument are these chevron indicator or a pair of vertical and horizontal bars, both chevron and bar flight indicators are command the planes, which means by flying towards them, they will regain or maintain the program flight path.
Q: What is the main topic in the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
我们在主飞行仪表看到的飞行指引仪是V形指引针或者是十字指引针，V形指引针和十字指引针都可以用来指引操纵飞机，也就是说，利用它们飞行，我们可以重获或者保持飞机计划航路。
问：表述的主题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Flight Directors.

cards.audioText:
Air France 145 is currently en-route from Paris to London Heathrow, the aircraft is descending to 3000 feet and requesting direct routing TLA. Air traffic control is unable to grant the request due to conflicting traffic at 3000 feet.
Q: Why did air traffic control denied the request of Air France 145?
cards.audioTextZh:
法航145正在从巴黎飞往伦敦希斯罗的航路上，飞机正在下降到3000英尺，并请求直飞TLA，由于在3000英尺有另一架冲突航空器，管制员无法同意该请求。
问：管制员为什么拒绝了法航145的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Conflicting Traffic.

cards.audioText:
Forecast conditions in Shanghai area this morning, expects ceiling 900 meters broken with 3000 meters overcast, visibility 4000 meters reducing to 1000 meters in heavy rain showers. Wind 320 at 10 m/s gusting 15 m/s.
Q: Which statement is not correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
今天早上上海地区天气预报：云高900米多云，3000米高空阴，能见度从4000米，大雨时降低到1000米，风向320，10米每秒，阵风15米每秒。
问：以下哪个叙述不正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Visibility is reducing to 3000m overcast.

cards.audioText:
The localizer transmitter is situated on extended runway centerline beyond the suburban. The localizer is being normally defined the centerline of runway and extends along the approach path for 25 miles with 40 ILS channels within the frequency range of 108.10 to 111.95 MHZ (megahertz) to provide pilots with course guidance.
Q: What is localizer used for?
cards.audioTextZh:
航向台定位信标发射机安装在跑道中心延长线以外一定距离内。一般而言，定位信标被认为是跑道的中心线，并沿着进近路线延伸25海里，在载波频率108.10到111.95MHZ范围内，包含40个ILS频道，为飞行员提供航路指引。
问：定位信标被用来做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Horizontal guidance.

cards.audioText:
Last week, whiling taxing to the runway we got a hydraulic low quantity warning. After confirming that we were losing fluid, we stopped and called for a tug. Unfortunately, we had to wait for nearly an hour before it came. By the time we finally changed planes and took off we were 2 hours late.
Q: How did they get back to the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
上周，在向跑道滑行的时候，我们收到了液压油量过低警告，确认我们正在漏油之后，我们停下飞机，并请求了拖车，不幸的是，我们足足等了快一个小时，拖车才赶到。到我们最后换了飞机并起飞时，我们晚了2个小时。
问：他们是如何回到停机位的？
choices: They went back on one engine.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They used a tug.

cards.audioText:
Because there was smoke, the commander ordered the passengers and crew to evacuate the aircraft in accordance with standard operation procedures.
Q: Who ordered people to evacuate the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
因为出现烟雾，机长根据标准操作程序命令所有乘客和机组成员从飞机撤离。
问：谁命令人们从飞机撤离？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The captain.

cards.audioText:
According to FAR, the minimum equipment required for flight in terminal control area, is the two-way radio, transponder and very-high-frequency omnidirectional radio range.
Q: What is the minimum equipment required to operate in the terminal controlled area?
cards.audioTextZh:
根据联邦航空条例，在航空终端站控制区飞行时，需要的最低设备是双向无线电设备，应答机，甚高频全向无电线信标。
问：在航空终端站控制区飞行时，所需要的最低设备有哪些？
choicesZh: 双向无线电设备和甚高频。
双向无线电设备，应答机和甚高频全向无线电信标。
甚高频全向无线电信标。
双向无线电设备，应答机和甚高频。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Two-way radio, transponder and VOR.

cards.audioText:
Every aircraft in flight generates wake turbulence, which trails downstream of the wing tips, this can be very dangerous, and requires aircraft to maintain a safe separation, when landing behind the larger aircraft, it’s important to stay at or above that aircraft final approach flight path and land beyond its touchdown point, this is especially important in calm wind conditions.
Q: When landing behind a larger aircraft, in which condition is especially important to stay at or above that aircraft final approach flight path?
cards.audioTextZh:
所有飞行的飞机都会产生尾流紊流，在翼尖形成下洗流。尾流紊流是很危险的，需要飞机保持安全间隔。因此，保持在或者高于飞机最后进近飞行线路以上高度和在其接点地之后着陆是非常重要的，这在静风条件下尤为重要。
问：在大飞机之后降落，在什么样的条件下，保持在或者高于飞机最后进近飞行路线高度尤为重要？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. calm wind.

cards.audioText:
Three elements require for a fire, they are oxygen, a combustible material such as passenger bags, computer equipment or fuel and ignition sources, such as heat. The most practical way to eliminate a fire is to remove oxygen supply.
Q: According to the statement, what is the best way to put out a fire?
cards.audioTextZh:
火需要三个基本条件：氧气，诸如乘客的背包、电脑设备或燃油等的可燃物，以及着火源，比如：高温。灭火的最实际的方法就是切断氧气供应。
问：根据表述，灭火的最佳方式是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To starve it of oxygen.

cards.audioText:
Clear ice is usually found between 0 and -10 degree, Mixed and clear ice between –10 and – 15 degrees. And rime ice between -15 and -20 degree Celsius.
Q: What type of ice is usually found between 0 degrees to minus 10 degrees?
cards.audioTextZh:
明冰一般出现在0度到-10度之间，毛冰一般出现在-10度到-15度之间，雾凇一般出现在-15度到-20度之间。
问：0度到-10度之间一般出现什么冰？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Clear ice.

cards.audioText:
Conditions which require immediate corrective action by the flight crew are indicated by red warning lights, located in the area of the pilot’s primate field vision. Conditions which require timely corrective action by the flight crew are indicated by amber caution lights. Blue lights do not require immediate crew attention.
Q: Which lights require timely corrective action by the flight crew?
cards.audioTextZh:
需要飞行机组成员立即做出更正行为的状况用红色警告灯指示，位于飞行员主要视角范围内。需要飞行机组及时做出更正行为的状况用琥珀色警示灯。蓝色灯不需要机组及时关注。
问：什么灯要求机组及时做出更正行为？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Amber lights.

cards.audioText:
Scanning in the sky for other aircraft is important to avoid mid-air collisions. Particularly when flying under visual flight rules.
Q: What is the reason to scan the sky for other aircraft, especially while flying under VFR?
cards.audioTextZh:
在目视飞行规则下，扫视空中的其他航空器来避免空中相撞是十分重要的。
问：在目视飞行规则下，扫视空中的其他航空器的原因是什么？
choices: To look for other aircraft clearly.
To prevent collisions in the air.
choicesZh: 为了更好看清其他飞机。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To prevent collisions in the air.

cards.audioText:
The safety investigation showed that runway incursion was caused by a communication problem. The pilot switched radio frequencies before the controller corrected his readback.
Q: What caused the communication problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
安全调查显示，造成这次跑道入侵的原因是沟通问题，管制员还没来得及更正飞行员的指令复诵，飞行员就更换了频率。
问：什么导致了沟通问题？
choices: The controller didn't hear the readback.
The pilot switched frequencies too soon.
choicesZh: 管制员没有听到飞行员复诵。
飞行员太快地转换了频率。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The pilot switched frequencies too soon.

cards.audioText:
During Engine start, some pilots think EGT and N1 are the most important to monitor but pilots should also monitor N2, fuel flow, start valve open light and engine start switches.
Q: According to the statement, what did some pilots think is the most important to monitor?
cards.audioTextZh:
在发动机启动时，一些飞行员认为发动机排气温度（EGT）和低压转子转速（N1）是需要关注的最重要参数。但飞行员也需要注意关注高压转子转速（N2）、燃油流量，启动阀灯和发动机启动开关。
问：根据表述，一些飞行员认为应该关注哪些最重要的参数？
choices: start valve open light and engine start switches.
choicesZh: 启动阀灯和发动机启动开关。
高压转子转速和发动机排气温度。
高压转子转速和燃油流量。
发动机排气温度和低压转子转速。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. EGT and N1

cards.audioText:
It is important to monitor tyre temperature prior to takeoff, because increasing temperature can lead to increasing tyre pressure, which causes the tyre to expand possibly to its blowout limit. This can have severe consequences.
Q: Why is it important to monitor tyre temperature before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
在起飞前，监控飞机轮胎温度是十分重要的，因为，轮胎温度的升高会导致轮胎压力的升高，这可能使轮胎膨胀到爆裂极限，导致严重后果。
问：起飞前，为什么监控飞机轮胎温度是非常重要的？
choices: To prevent the tyre expanding a little.
choicesZh: 为了防止轮胎些许膨胀。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To prevent tyre blowout.

cards.audioText:
That group of tourists will have to take a later flight because they can't get the airport in time. There has been a major accident on the main road to the airport so they have to take detour.
Q: Why can’t they get to the airport in time?
cards.audioTextZh:
旅行团成员因为没有及时到达机场，所以必须乘坐后续的航班。去机场的道路发生了一起重大交通事故，因此，他们必须绕路。
问：他们为什么没有及时到机场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The main road is closed.

cards.audioText:
The localizer transmitter is situated on extended runway centerline beyond the start ben. The localizer is being normally defined the centerline of runway and extends along the approach path for 25 miles with 40 ILS channels within the frequency range of 108.10 to 111.95 megahertz to provide pilots with course guidance.
Q: What is localizer used for?
cards.audioTextZh:
航向台定位信标发射机安装在跑道中心延长线以外一定距离内。一般而言，定位信标被认为是跑道的中心线，并沿着进近路线延伸25海里，在载波频率108.10到111.95MHZ范围内，包含40个ILS频道，为飞行员提供航路指引。
问：定位信标被用来做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Horizontal guidance.

cards.audioText:
Required runway length for takeoff and landing might vary considerably with changes of outside temperature, runway surface, aircraft load and field elevation.
Q: According to the statement, which of the following will NOT affect the required runway length for takeoff and landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
用于起飞和着陆的所需跑道长度会随着外界气温、跑道道面情况、飞机业载和跑道海拔高度的不同而变化。
问：根据表述，下列哪一项不会影响起飞和着陆期间的所需跑道长度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Light wind.

cards.audioText:
A rapid exit taxiway is connected to a runway at an acute angle and designed to allow landing airplanes to turn off the runway at higher speeds. Thereby minimizing runway occupancy time so as to increase runway efficiency.
Q: At what angle should the rapid exit taxiway be connected with the runway?
cards.audioTextZh:
快速脱离滑行道与机场跑道呈锐角角度连接，目的在于使航空器以较高的速度脱离跑道，旨在缩短占用跑道时间，提高跑道利用效率。
问：快速脱离滑行道与机场跑道以什么样的角度连接？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Less than 90 degrees.

cards.audioText:
A bomb threat closed the larger airport, so many aircraft would divert to a smaller airport, about an hour away, because of the large number of diverted aircraft, the taxiways at the smaller airport were blocked. As a result, planes had to taxi onto a single active runway, taxi to the opposite end, turn around and then take off.
Q: Why did aircraft have to use the active runway as a taxiway?
cards.audioTextZh:
一大机场由于炸弹威胁而关闭，因此，许多飞机备降至离大机场一小时外的小机场，由于备降的飞机数量过多，导致小机场的滑行道阻塞，结果，飞机不得不在唯一的一条使用中跑道上滑行，滑行到跑道对面，然后调头起飞。
问：飞机为什么用使用中跑道当滑行道？
choices: It wasn't used as a taxiway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The taxiways were blocked.

cards.audioText:
Most radios current manufactures have either 360 or 720 channel capacity. A 360-channel radio uses 50khz spacing between the channels such as 118.05 and 118.10. A 720-channel radio double the frequency available by using 25khz spacing.
Q: What spacing does a 360-channel radio have between channels?
cards.audioTextZh:
大部分的无线电制造商有360或720的频道容量。一个360频道容量的无线电使用50千赫作为频道与频道的间隔，比如118.05和118.10；一个720频道容量的无线电使用25千赫作为间隔，因此使得可用频道翻倍。
问：一个360频道容量的无线电使用的频道与频道之间的间隔是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 50KHz channel spacing

cards.audioText:
Sometimes the controller might provide a weather and avoidance clearance to the pilots, such clearance always contains the direction and distance.
Q: What will be contained in an avoidance clearance?
cards.audioTextZh:
有时候，管制员会向飞行员提供天气信息和避让许可，这些许可通常包括方向和距离。
问：在避让许可中包含的信息有哪些？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Both direction and distance.

cards.audioText:
Star Engine System is an aircraft engine manufacture. It used to be a very profitable company. In fact, it was profitable until about 5 years ago when it failed to design more fuel efficient engines and it has some serious safety problems. Its engines did not do well in high power stress tests.
Q: What is one reason the company hasn’t done well?
cards.audioTextZh:
STAR发动机系统曾是一家飞机发动机制造商，这家公司曾是一家盈利的公司。事实上，5年前，公司无法设计出更节省燃油的发动机，并出现严重安全问题后，公司就不再盈利。这家公司生产的发动机在大功率压力测试中表现不好。
问：这家公司表现不好的原因是什么？
choices: Its engines were not fuel efficient enough.
It has been profitable for 5 years.
Its engines were not powerful enough.
choicesZh: 公司生产的发动机经济型不够好。
公司生产的发动机有很好的设计。
公司生产的发动没有足够的动力。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Its engines were not fuel efficient enough.

cards.audioText:
Clearway is defined area on the ground or water under the control of the appropriate authority. The length of the clearway should not exceed 50 percent the length of the takeoff run available.
Q: How long should clearway be according to what do you heard?
cards.audioTextZh:
净空道是于地面或水面上划定一块由机场当局管理的长方形区域，其长度不应超过可用起飞滑跑距离的50%。
问：根据所听到的内容，净空道的长度应该多长？
choices: No less than half the distance of TORA.
No more than half the distance of TORA.
choicesZh: 不少于起飞滑跑距离的一半。
不多于起飞滑跑距离的一半。
和起飞滑跑距离一样长。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. No more than half the distance of TORA.

cards.audioText:
The controller confused the call signs of two aircraft in the hold and issued instructions to the wrong one. Fortunately, the crew asked for confirmation, so the controller realized the mistake and made the correction.
Q: What did the crew do after receiving the instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员混淆了两架等待中的飞机呼号，将指令错误得发给了另外一架飞机。幸运的是，机组成员进行了确认，管制员意识到了错误并进行了更正。
问：机组收到管制指令后是如何做的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Asked for confirmation.

cards.audioText:
An aircraft has just taken off, the crew is expecting to turn right and proceed to waypoint YB which is the exit point on the SID. As they pass 600m, Departure Control instructs them to turn right and proceed direct to VINI, a waypoint that the crew doesn’t understand or recognize, so the crew decide to contact Departure Control.
Q: Why does the crew need to contact Departure Control?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机刚刚起飞，机组计划右转直飞航路点YB，这是标准仪表离场程序中的出口点。当他们过600米后，离场管制指示他们右转直飞VINI点，机组对这个点并不理解和清楚，于是，机组决定联系离场管制。
问：机组成员为什么需要联系离场管制？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Waypoint VINI is unrecognized.

cards.audioText:
My best friend used to fly for Thai airways, he lived there for more than 10 years until he was offered a much better job with Air France, now he is trying to decide whether he should take an even better job with Air China or stay in France, one problem is that he doesn’t speak Chinese.
Q: Which statement is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
我的朋友之前在泰航飞，在得到法航一份更好的工作前，他在泰国已经生活了10多年。现在，他在考虑是否接受国航更好的工作或者继续留在法国。但有一个问题就是他不会说汉语。
问：以下哪个叙述是正确的？
choices: He has decided to go to Air China.
He has lived in France for 10 years.
The best job is with Air China.
He's going to leave Air France.
choicesZh: 他已经决定去国航工作。
他在法国已经生活了10多年。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The best job is with Air China.

cards.audioText:
A controller instructed CCA101 to leave 9,500m for 8,900m. He then found his instruction was not correct and changed the instruction by asking CCA101 descending to 9,200m.
Q: Which word can be used to express the controller's meaning?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员指挥国航101离开9500米到8900米，他后来发现自己的指令有误，于是将指令更改为让国航101下降到9200米。
问：下列哪个词语可以用来表达管制员的指令？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. correction.

cards.audioText:
In flight, icing conditions exist when the air temperature is below freezing, but some water in the cloud is liquid. The most important feature of the cloud that affects ice build up is the amount of liquid water in the cloud and the size of the water droplets. Generally, the first signs of an icing problem are decreasing airspeed, Decreasing climb rate or a higher than normal power setting for a selected airspeed.
Q: What is one of the first signs of icing problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
在飞行中，当空气温度低于冰点时就会结冰，但云中的一些水是液态的。云中影响冰形成的最重要的特征是云中液态水的数量和水滴的大小。通常，结冰问题的第一个迹象是空速下降，爬升率下降或高于选定空速的正常功率设置。
问：出现积冰问题的第一个迹象是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. decreasing air speed.

cards.audioText:
Generally speaking, depressing things are drugs that can reduce body functioning in many areas. The lower blood pressure reduces mental processing and slow mote on reaction response. There are several types of drug that can cause depressing effect on the body. As much as fact, the most common of this is alcohol.
Q: How does alcohol usually reduce the body’s functioning?
cards.audioTextZh:
一般而言，降凝类药物可在很多方面降低身体机能，血压过低会降低思维处理能力并降低行为反应速度，很多药物可以导致身体产生降凝反应，事实上，最常见的就是酒精。
问：酒精是如何降低身体机能的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Reduce mental processing.

cards.audioText:
Panpan Panpan Panpan, NW401 declaring an emergency, we have to shut down No. 2 engine due to bird strike and engine lost power, request return for immediate landing. Current position 10 miles south of YHU
Q: Why was the engine shut down?
cards.audioTextZh:
Panpan，Panpan，Panpan，西北航空401，宣布紧急状态，由于鸟击，飞机失去动力，我们已将二号发动机关闭，请求返航并立即着陆。目前位于YHU以南10海里。
问：为什么关闭发动机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because of bird ingestion.

cards.audioText:
Before the flight, pilots used to have all necessary documents in hand including the weather forecast, the flight plan, VOLMET, NOTAM etc. Nowadays the electronic flight packages have been widely used in modern aircraft.
Q: Which document is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
在飞行前，飞行员通常会准备好所有必要的文件，包括天气预报、飞行计划、航空气象资料、飞行员通告等。如今，电子飞行包已广泛应用于现代飞机。
问：没有提及哪一个文件？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. navigation pages

cards.audioText:
In low visibility situations like fog or heavy rain, pilots often struggle to spot other airplanes around them. This becomes a crucial challenge because it's essential for safety to know the position of nearby aircraft.
Question: What is one of the main challenges for pilots during low visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh:
在大雾或大雨等能见度较低的情况下，飞行员往往很难发现周围的其他飞机。这是一个至关重要的挑战，因为了解附近飞机的位置对安全至关重要。
问：飞行员在低能见度条件下面临的主要挑战之一是什么？
choices: Communicating with the air traffic control clearly.
Identifying other aircraft in the vicinity.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Identifying other aircraft in the vicinity.

cards.audioText:
To help pilots during low visibility, airports usually enhance the lighting on the runways. By increasing the number of runway lights, it becomes a bit easier for pilots to identify the runway and make a safe landing or takeoff.
Question: What might an airport do to assist pilots during periods of low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh:
为了在低能见度时帮助飞行员，机场通常会加强跑道上的照明。通过增加跑道灯的数量，飞行员可以更容易地识别跑道并安全着陆或起飞。
问：在低能见度期间，机场可以做些什么来帮助飞行员？
choices: Increase the number of runway lights.
Ask all aircraft to circle above until visibility improves.
Ask all aircraft to circle below until visibility improves.
choicesZh: 要求所有飞机在上空盘旋，直到能见度提高
要求所有飞机在下方盘旋，直到能见度提高
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Increase the number of runway lights.

cards.audioText:
In low visibility conditions, air traffic control has to increase the separation distance between aircraft to reduce the risk of collision. Since it's harder for pilots to see other planes, more space is needed to ensure safety.
Question: How does low visibility affect the separation distance between aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
在低能见度条件下，空中交通管制必须增加飞机之间的距离，以减少碰撞的风险。由于飞行员很难看到其他飞机，因此需要更多的空间来确保安全。
问：低能见度如何影响飞机之间的距离？
choices: The separation distance needs to be decrease.
The separation distance remains the same.
The separation distance needs to be increase.
Separation distance is not considered during low visibility.
choicesZh: 在低能见度下，不考虑间隔距离
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The separation distance needs to be increase.

cards.audioText:
Airlines follow strict safety protocols, and one of them is that they won't initiate takeoffs during low visibility until the visibility improves to a specific minimum level required for a safe departure as per regulations.
Question: Which of the following is a safety protocol for airlines during low visibility takeoffs?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空公司遵循严格的安全协议，其中之一是他们不会在低能见度下进行起飞，直到能见度提高到安全起飞所需的特定最低水平。
问题：以下哪项是航空公司在低能见度起飞时的安全协议？
choices: Having an extra crew member on standby.
Waiting for visibility to improve to a certain minimum level.
choicesZh: 等待能见度提升到特定的最低标准
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Waiting for visibility to improve to a certain minimum level.

cards.audioText:
Pilots communicate with each other in the air using a specific air-to-air communication frequency. This allows them to share information about traffic, weather, or any other relevant details when necessary.
Question: How do pilots communicate with each other in the air?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员在空中使用特定的空对空通信频率相互通信。这使得他们可以在必要时分享交通、天气或任何其他相关细节的信息。
问：飞行员如何在空中相互沟通？
choices: Using a specific air-to-air communication frequency.
choicesZh: 使用特定的空对空通信频率
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Using a specific air-to-air communication frequency.

cards.audioText:
Pilots use a VHF radio to communicate with air traffic control. The VHF radio is reliable and widely used in aviation for short-range communication within a certain area of airspace.
Question: What device do pilots use to communicate with air traffic control?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员使用甚高频无线电与空中交通管制员通信。甚高频无线电是一种可靠的无线电，在航空领域广泛应用于一定空域范围内的近距离通信。
问：飞行员用什么设备与空中交通管制员通信？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. VHF radio.

cards.audioText:
Air traffic control uses different frequencies for different aircraft. This helps to manage the communication and avoid interference, allowing them to clearly communicate with each aircraft in a busy airspace.
Question: How does air traffic control ensure clear communication with multiple aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
空中交通管制对不同的飞机使用不同的频率。这有助于管理通信，避免干扰，使他们能够在繁忙的空域与每架飞机清晰地通信。
问：空中交通管制如何确保与多架飞机的通讯畅通？
choices: By using different frequencies for different aircraft.
By only communicating with one aircraft at a time.
choicesZh: 针对不同飞机，使用不同频率
每次只与一架飞机通信
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. By using different frequencies for different aircraft.

cards.audioText:
The transponder sends information about the aircraft's identity, altitude, and speed to air traffic control. This helps air traffic controllers to track and manage the aircraft more effectively in the airspace.
Question: What is the role of the transponder in aviation communication?
cards.audioTextZh:
应答器向空中交通管制中心发送有关飞机身份、高度和速度的信息。这有助于空中交通管制员在空域内更有效地跟踪和管理飞机。
问：应答器在航空通信中的作用是什么？
choices: To send information about the aircraft's to ATC.
To receive radio signals from other aircraft
To boost the power of the VHF radio.
choicesZh: 向空中交通管制中心发送有关飞机的信息
接收来自其他飞机的无线电信号
提高甚高频无线电的功率
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To send information about the aircraft's to ATC.

cards.audioText:
Pilots rely heavily on the GPS receiver for en-route navigation. It provides accurate position information, allowing them to follow the planned flight path and make necessary course adjustments.
Question: What is the primary navigation instrument used by pilots for en-route navigation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员严重依赖GPS接收器进行航路导航。它提供准确的位置信息，使他们能够遵循计划的飞行路线并进行必要的航线调整。
问：飞行员在航路中使用的主要导航仪器是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. GPS receiver.

cards.audioText: Solar flares can cause a GPS signal interruption during flight. The electromagnetic radiation from solar flares can disrupt the satellite signals, leading to a loss or degradation of GPS accuracy. Question: What might cause a GPS signal interruption during flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
太阳耀斑会在飞行过程中导致GPS信号中断。来自太阳耀斑的电磁辐射会干扰卫星信号，导致GPS精度的损失或降低。
问：飞行中什么可能导致GPS信号中断？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Solar flares.

cards.audioText:
A VOR transmits a radio signal. The aircraft's receiver picks up this signal and can calculate the bearing to the VOR station. Pilots can use this information to navigate along a specific radial and reach their intended destination.
Question: How does a VOR work to assist in navigation?
cards.audioTextZh:
VOR发送无线电信号。飞机的接收器接收到这个信号，并可以计算到VOR台的方位。飞行员可以利用这些信息沿着特定的径向导航并到达预定的目的地。
问：VOR是如何协助航行的？
choices: It uses satellite signals to determine position.
It transmits a radio signal to calculate the bearing to the station.
It detects other aircraft in the vicinity.
choicesZh: 它使用卫星信号来确定位置
它向电台发送无线电信号来计算方位
它能探测到附近的其他飞机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. It transmits a radio signal to calculate the bearing to the station.

cards.audioText:
Incorrectly entered flight plan data can be a common source of error in navigation systems. If the initial coordinates or way points are wrong, it can lead the aircraft off course.
Question: What is a common source of error in navigation systems?
cards.audioTextZh:
错误输入的飞行计划数据可能是导航系统误差的常见来源。如果初始坐标或航点不正确，可能会导致飞行器偏离航线。
问：导航系统误差的常见来源是什么？
choicesZh: 错误输入飞行计划数据
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Incorrectly entered flight plan data.

cards.audioText:
Pilots can update their navigation systems during flight through satellite data links or ground-based radio updates. These methods allow them to receive updated information about
airspace changes, navigation aids, or weather-related data.
Question: How do pilots update their navigation systems during flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员可以在飞行过程中通过卫星数据链或地面无线电更新来更新其导航系统。这些方法使他们能够接收关于空域变化、导航辅助设施或天气相关数据的更新信息。
问：飞行员如何在飞行中更新导航系统？
choices: By landing and connecting to a computer.
Through satellite data links or ground-based radio updates.
By asking the air traffic controller to do it.
choicesZh: 通过着陆后接通计算机
通过卫星数据链或地面无线电更新
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Through satellite data links or ground-based radio updates.

cards.audioText:
The oxygen regulator controls the flow and pressure of oxygen to the masks. It ensures that the right amount of oxygen is delivered to the passengers and crew based on the altitude and other factors.
Question: What is the role of the oxygen regulator in the system?
cards.audioTextZh:
氧气调节器控制面罩的氧气流量和压力。它确保根据海拔高度和其他因素向乘客和机组人员输送适量的氧气。
问：系统中氧气调节器的作用是什么？
choices: To control the flow and pressure of oxygen to the masks.
To detect leaks in the system.
To clean the oxygen before it reaches the masks.
choicesZh: 控制进入到氧气面罩的氧气流量和压力
在氧气到达面罩之前净化氧气
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To control the flow and pressure of oxygen to the masks.

cards.audioText:
Before any flight, the first and crucial step is to conduct a thorough walk-around inspection of the aircraft. Pilots need to visually check the exterior for any signs of damage, loose parts, or fluid leaks.
Question: What is the first step in pre-flight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh:
在任何飞行之前，第一步也是至关重要的一步是对飞机进行彻底的绕机检查。飞行员需要目视检查飞机外部是否有任何损坏、部件松动或液体泄漏的迹象。
问：飞行前准备的第一步是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Conducting a walk-around inspection.

cards.audioText:
The aircraft's maintenance log is essential to review during pre-flight preparation. It provides information about the recent maintenance work done on the aircraft, any outstanding issues, and whether the plane is in a fit state to fly.
Question: What document is essential to review during pre-flight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机的维修日志在飞行前的准备过程中是必不可少的。它提供了有关飞机最近维修工作的信息，任何未解决的问题，以及飞机是否处于适合飞行的状态。
问：飞行前准备期间，必须审查什么文件？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft's maintenance log.

cards.audioText:
During pre-flight, a pilot should check the freedom of movement and proper connection of all flight controls. This ensures that the ailerons, elevators, rudder, and other controls respond correctly and smoothly.
Question: What should a pilot check regarding the flight controls during pre-flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行前，飞行员应检查所有飞行操纵装置的活动自由度和正确连接。这确保副翼、升降舵、方向舵和其他操纵装置能够正确、顺畅地响应。
问：飞行前，飞行员应检查飞行操纵装置的什么方面？
choices: Only the position of the control surfaces.
The freedom of movement and proper connection of all flight controls.
The color of the control knobs.
The sound made when the controls are moving.
choicesZh: 所有飞行操纵装置的活动自由度和正确连接
操纵装置移动时发出的声音
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The freedom of movement and proper connection of all flight controls.

cards.audioText:
The altimeter is an instrument that is checked for its accuracy during pre-flight. An incorrect altimeter reading can lead to issues with altitude separation and safe flight operations.
Question: What instrument is checked for its accuracy during pre-flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
高度表是飞行前需检查其准确性的仪表。错误的高度表读数可能导致高度间隔问题和安全飞行操作问题。
问：飞行前检查准确性的仪表是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The altimeter.

cards.audioText:
The final step in pre-flight preparation is double-checking all the systems one last time and getting clearance from air traffic control to taxi. This ensures that everything is in order and the flight can commence safely.
Question: What is the final step in pre-flight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行前准备的最后一步是最后一次复核所有系统，并获得空中交通管制的滑行许可。这确保一切就绪，航班可以安全开始。
问：飞行前准备的最后一步是什么？
choices: Ordering a last-minute snack from the airport.
Taking a selfie with the aircraft.
choicesZh: 在机场点一份最后一刻的零食
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Double-checking all the systems.

cards.audioText:
The crew of flight 2615 initiated an emergency descent to 10,000 feet due to the loss of cabin pressure, the passenger oxygen masks were released.
Question: What is the reason for emergency descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
机组因客舱失压，启动紧急下降至10,000英尺，旅客氧气面罩已释放。
问：紧急下降的原因是什么？
choices: Due loss of engine oil pressure.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due loss of cabin pressure.

cards.audioText:
The airline reported during takeoff roll the aircraft sustained a bird strike prompting the crew to reject takeoff. The aircraft was grounded for inspection.
Question: What is the reason for rejected takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空公司报告称，起飞滑跑期间飞机遭遇鸟击，导致机组中断起飞。飞机已停场检查。
问：中断起飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to bird strike.

cards.audioText:
A Level Bust or Altitude Deviation occurs when an aircraft fails to fly at the level to which it has been cleared, regardless of whether actual loss of separation from other aircraft or the ground results.
Question: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
当飞机未能按已获许可的高度飞行时，即发生高度偏差或高度偏离，无论是否实际导致与其他飞机或地面失去间隔。
问：说话者主要谈论的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Level deviation.

cards.audioText:
Pre-flight preparation includes weight and balance computations, pre-flight briefing, pre-flight external inspection, pre-flight cockpit system check, servicing and operation of engine.
Question: Which of the following is not included in pre-flight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行前准备包括重量与平衡计算、飞行前简令、飞行前外部检查、飞行前驾驶舱系统检查、勤务及发动机操作。
问：以下哪项不属于飞行前准备？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engine startup.

cards.audioText:
According to the provisions in ICAO Annex 6 “Operation of Aircraft”, Fixed-wing aeroplanes and helicopters shall be equipped with a cockpit voice recorder with a recording duration of at least 30 minutes of its operation.
Question: What's the CVR's recording duration requirement of fixed-wing airplanes and helicopters?
cards.audioTextZh:
根据ICAO附件6《航空器运行》的规定，固定翼飞机和直升机应配备驾驶舱话音记录器，其记录时长至少为30分钟。
问：固定翼飞机和直升机的CVR记录时长要求是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. At least 30 minutes.

cards.audioText:
On January 3, 2023, the crew of Air France72 observed anomalies with one of the engine oil systems, subsequently shut down the engine due to loss of oil pressure, dumped fuel and returned to Paris.
Question: Why did Air France72 shut down the engine?
cards.audioTextZh:
2023年1月3日，法国航空72号航班机组观察到其中一个发动机滑油系统出现异常，随后因滑油压力丧失而关闭了该发动机，放油并返航巴黎。
问：法国航空72号航班为何关闭发动机？
choices: Due to problem with engine oil system.
Due to problem with engine fuel system.
Due to problem with engine fuel pump.
choicesZh: 因发动机滑油系统问题
因发动机燃油系统问题
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to problem with engine oil system.

cards.audioText:
As far as fuel pump system is concerned, it is usually found in low wing airplane with fuel tanks may be normally located below the engine.
Question: Where is fuel pump system normally used?
cards.audioTextZh:
就燃油泵系统而言，通常见于油箱可能位于发动机下方的下单翼飞机。
问：燃油泵系统通常用于哪种飞机？
choices: On airplanes with tanks in the engine.
On airplanes with tanks below the engine.
On airplanes with tanks next to engine.
On airplanes with tanks above the engine.
choicesZh: 油箱在发动机内的飞机
油箱在发动机下方的飞机
油箱在发动机旁边的飞机
油箱在发动机上方的飞机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. On airplanes with tanks below the engine.
